==Purpose of template==
Select a (possibly random) quote.

==How to use==

<pre>
{{wotq}}
{{wotq|tags}}
{{wotq|{{PAGENAME}}}}
</pre>

==Examples==

{| class="wikitable"
| Description
| Code
| Result
|-
| Random quote
| <pre>{{wotq}}</pre>
|         {{wotq}}
|-
| Random quote related to a named character
| <pre>{{wotq|Mat}}</pre>
|         {{wotq|Mat}}
|-
| Random quote related to a named character using an alias
| <pre>{{wotq|Nyn}}</pre>
|         {{wotq|Nyn}}
|-
| Random quote ''not'' related to named character
| <pre>{{wotq|all
!Rand}}</pre>
|         {{wotq|all
!Rand}}
|-
| Random quote related to a named character ''not'' related to another named character
| <pre>{{wotq|Mat
Rand}}</pre>
|         {{wotq|Mat
Rand}}
|-
| No quotes found
| <pre>{{wotq|oajwofiawoief}}</pre>
|      {{wotq|oajwofiawoief}}
|-
|}
